name: V4 Studio for Elementor
author: Webraders

sections.description:
V4 Studio gives your Elementor V4 site a ready-made design system. Choose your colors, fonts and spacing once, then use them everywhere, without writing code.

When you activate it, V4 Studio adds 146 variables and 687 global classes built on them to Elementor. You can change them from one screen.

Documentation · Quick Start · Free Wireframes

🌟 What you get

  • Design Tokens: colors, text sizes, fonts, spacing, sizes, layout widths and corner radius in one place, saved as Elementor variables. Build a palette from one color, an image or at random. Text sizes, spacing, sizes and corner radius grow from a phone to a large screen. Aliases name a job, like card padding.
  • Ready-made classes: 687 global classes for buttons, cards, text, layout and more. Edit them in Elementor’s class editor. Restore Shipped Classes puts the originals back.
  • Free wireframes: ready-made sections on free.v4.studio, like heroes, features, pricing and footers. Copy or download them, with no account. They are not inside the plugin, and a few contact sections use Elementor Pro’s form.
  • Brand Data: your company name, logos, contact details and social links, used anywhere through Elementor’s free dynamic tags. New sites start with made-up sample details and two sample logos in the Media Library.
  • Import / Export: move your design tokens and Brand Data to another site in one JSON file.

✅ Safe saving

V4 Studio checks every value before saving. If one is not valid, it tells you which, and nothing from that save is written. Imported values get the same checks; anything that does not pass is listed and left out. A section’s Reset shows its original values for you to add again, and Reset All to Defaults asks first.

🛟 Backup styles

Until V4 Studio has confirmed that Elementor holds the whole design system, it adds its own copy of the styles to your pages as inline styles (v4studio-custom-css and v4studio-fallback-variables), and a notice with Verify Now tells you. Every page also gets a small inline style, v4studio-composition-properties, that registers six CSS custom properties the classes use.

Copyright © 2026 Webraders. V4 Studio for Elementor, including its bundled images, is distributed under the GPLv2 or later license. The V4 Studio name and logo are trademarks of Webraders.

External Services

V4 Studio itself makes no requests to other hosts: not from its admin screens, not from the pages it outputs, and not from the server. Its font preview uses only fonts on your computer or stored on this site.

The default font tokens name Google Fonts families (Hanken Grotesk, DM Sans, Space Mono and Playfair Display). While Elementor’s Google Fonts are on and its “Load Google Fonts Locally” setting is off, Elementor has visitors’ browsers load these families from Google Fonts (https://fonts.google.com/), under Google’s Terms of Service (https://policies.google.com/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy). To avoid that, choose other font tokens, turn on “Load Google Fonts Locally”, or turn off Google Fonts in Elementor.

The V4 Studio screen and the Plugins screen link to free.v4.studio and v4.studio; the links open only when clicked.

Security

Only users with manage_options can use the V4 Studio screen. Each AJAX action checks that capability and its own nonce. A save from a page that is out of date is refused. Import text is limited to 10 MB, measured after markup is removed, and to 64 levels of nesting.

Data Stored

Options: v4studio_settings (all settings, including Brand Data and the token values), v4studio_fallback_css_key, v4studio_fallback_reverify_pending, v4studio_tokens_save_lock (only while a save runs) and v4studio_class_update_undo. Transients: the generated backup stylesheet, and v4studio_custom_font_faces (one hour). User meta: v4studio_backup_notice_dismissed.

A site administrator can keep the backup stylesheet on with the V4STUDIO_FORCE_FALLBACK_CSS constant or the v4studio_force_fallback_css option; V4 Studio reads both and never writes the option; uninstall deletes it.

Kept on uninstall: v4studio_variables_id_map (the Elementor variables V4 Studio created), v4studio_variables_bootstrap (written when “Reset All to Defaults” takes over variables V4 Studio has no record of), v4studio_variables_ingest_claim_journal (an interrupted write, when one exists), the sample logos with their _v4studio_placeholder_logo and _v4studio_placeholder_logo_rev post meta, and any _v4studio_elementor_data_backup and _v4studio_elementor_data_backup_time post meta an earlier version left.

Uninstalling removes everything else listed above, and records an earlier version stored, on every site of a network, including Brand Data. Elementor’s global classes and variables stay. Use WordPress’s “Delete” action; deleting the files by hand does not run the uninstall.

Browser storage: v4studioTheme (the light or dark mode of the V4 Studio screen), kept in the administrator’s browser.

Source

All of V4 Studio’s code ships readable in this plugin. defaults/class-history.json is built with Class_History::build() from defaults/class-history/classes-1.0.0.css and defaults/classes.css; includes/data/css-properties.php is the maintained list of CSS property names.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor. Its Atomic Editor (V4) must be on; it is on by default from Elementor 4.4.
  2. Go to Plugins › Add New Plugin, search for V4 Studio, select Install Now, then Activate.
  3. As an administrator, open any admin page. V4 Studio adds its variables and classes to Elementor. Open V4 Studio in the WordPress menu to see them.

Guide with pictures: Installation.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. A few contact sections in the free wireframes use Elementor Pro’s form.

Where do I add my own CSS?

In a class’s Custom CSS section in Elementor’s class editor. That section needs Elementor Pro.

Why are the classes missing right after activation?

They are added the first time an administrator opens an admin page. If they are still missing, open V4 Studio and read its notices.

V4 Studio says it needs Elementor’s Atomic Editor

Use the button in V4 Studio’s notice to open Elementor’s settings and turn the Atomic Editor (V4) on. Until then V4 Studio adds no classes or variables; Brand Data still works.

Why do sizes show as var() text in Elementor?

Size tokens are saved as var(--token) values. Each one shows the token’s value, follows the token and stays editable.

Where can I find more help?

See the documentation and Troubleshooting, or ask in this plugin’s support forum.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

First public release. Tested with Elementor and Elementor Pro 4.4.

  • Design tokens: colours, type scale, fluid spacing, fluid size, layout width, radius and aliases, all as Elementor variables.
  • Contrast check: shows whether your text and background colours are easy to read.
  • Brand Data: your name, contact details, logos and links in one place.
  • Ready-made classes: a full set of classes for Elementor’s atomic editor.
  • Classes card: Verify, Add Missing Defaults, Update Changed Classes and Undo in one Details popup.

1.0.0

  • Preview release.

screenshots.caption: Color Palette, built from one color and a harmony.
Type Scale: fluid text sizes, previewed on desktop, tablet and phone.
Fonts: heading, body, accent and quote fonts.
Fluid Spacing: values for phones and large screens. Fluid Size and Fluid Radius work the same way.
Aliases: names for a job that point to another value.
Brand Data: company details and links for Elementor dynamic tags.
Import / Export: move design tokens and Brand Data in one JSON file.
Free Wireframes on free.v4.studio: copy or download ready-made sections, no account needed. Not inside the plugin.
Documentation on free.v4.studio: live previews of the bundled classes.
